text: キングスムーアFCは38分、ビクター・クインランの短いパスからフェリックス・ドゥアルテが約2メートルの距離でシュートを放ちましたが、惜しくもゴールを外しました。このチャンスは約57秒かけて11回パスをつなぎ、相手陣深くまでボールを運んで作り出されました。非常に良いチャンスでしたが、決めきれず現在のスコアは2-2の同点です[#713][#710][#695]。

trace.output: Brief: Big chance missed - Felix Duarte for fan audience in ja

- Felix Duarte missed a big chance with an xG of 0.989, shooting off target with his foot from 2.1 meters in open play [#713].
- The chance came after a build-up involving 11 passes over 56.5 seconds, starting from a throw-in on Kingsmoor FC's own side at x=95.3 [#695, #709].
- Viktor Quinlan assisted the shot with a short key pass [#710].
- At this moment, the score was tied at 2-2 between Kingsmoor FC and Westport Albion.
- Kingsmoor FC had possession dominance with 52.4%, 3 shots, 0 shots on target, and 1 big chance in the last 10 minutes.

- The big chance arose from a sustained build-up play starting from a throw-in deep in Kingsmoor FC’s own half, involving 11 passes and lasting 56.5 seconds, demonstrating patient, possession-based football that fits Kingsmoor’s 4-4-2 formation and wide, crossing style. The ball was circulated among midfield and defenders (players like Fairweather, Strand, and Sato) to create space and progress forward [#695-#709].
- The final progression included a long, progressive pass by Hamza Strand into the final third to Viktor Quinlan, followed by a short key pass to Felix Duarte, who took a close-range shot off-target. This sequence reflects an overload and combination play through wide areas before trying to feed a striker in the box, consistent with Kingsmoor’s tactical approach emphasizing wide service and crossings, although here executed through short passes and carry rather than crossing [#709-#713].
- Westport Albion’s 4-4-2 with direct, vertical passing and higher PPDA (pressing intensity) led to more turnovers (5 high turnovers in last 10 minutes), but Kingsmoor’s methodical buildup in this moment avoided immediate pressing pressure, enabling the chance to develop patiently without being directly dispossessed [#last_10_minutes].
- The chance happened deep into the build-up with a mix of midfield rotations and progressive carries, showing Kingsmoor FC’s ability to patiently work through Westport’s lines, aligning with their tactical emphasis on possession and wide play rather than direct vertical attacks seen from Westport Albion.
